description: AutoGen AgentChat agent run with one tool call, traced by the AutoGen OpenInference instrumentor only.
notes: Only AutogenAgentChatInstrumentor is enabled, with AUTOGEN_DISABLE_RUNTIME_TRACING set before autogen is imported. The OpenAI instrumentor is not enabled: it would add a second llm span for each model call (D-IN-23 item 3). Each model call is one llm span, OpenAIChatCompletionClient.create. The model client is pointed at the mock.
